base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y jq unzip wget ca-certificates
activation_command: export GOROOT=/usr/local/go && export GOPATH=/home/agent_sandbox/go && export PATH=$GOROOT/bin:$GOPATH/bin:$PATH && export GOPROXY=${GOPROXY:-http://mirror.proxy.hpc:8081/repository/go-proxy/,direct}
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export GOROOT=/usr/local/go && export GOPATH=/home/agent_sandbox/go && export PATH=$GOROOT/bin:$GOPATH/bin:$PATH && go version && conftest --version'

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: go mod download in each test directory
runtime_profile.notes: Terraform CLI should be pre-installed in base image or installed during container build when network access is available. Go modules are initialized for all test directories.

notes: Base image: golang:1.23.2 (includes Go 1.23.2, git, and curl pre-installed). Git and curl are provided by the golang base image, so they are not listed in system_packages. Go 1.23.2 is pre-installed at /usr/local/go. Conftest v0.48.0 installed via go install (pinned for Go 1.23.2 compatibility). Terraform CLI requires network access for installation - recommend including in base image. Test framework: Terratest (Go) with OPA/conftest for policy validation.
